''See also: [[Kelarac Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kelarac, whose name translates to the Collector of Souls, is a [[Great Elder]] known for his reputation as a cunning negotiator. Unlike his peers, he possesses no specific domain and historically traveled through the territories of other [[Elders]]. He is characterized by his tendency to strike bargains that often result in misfortune for the other party, though he is noted for always honoring his agreements. He gathers power by granting human wishes in exchange for valuable items, such as relics, artifacts, [[blood]], sanity, or personal loyalty. While some view him as a potential bridge for interaction between humans and non-humans, others recognize that he views humanity as being in a position of subservience to him. Physically, Kelarac has been described in various forms. One account depicts him as a man with a trimmed beard, wearing jewelry and fashionable clothing, though he is distinguished by a permanent [[steel]] blindfold bolted over his eyes. Other descriptions portray him as a massive, island-sized sea creature with the appearance of a shark and stony skin. He is currently believed to be bound within a submerged city beneath the [[Aion]]. Legends suggest that individuals can attempt to gain his attention through focused [[Intent]] and a [[sacrifice]] of something valuable cast into the [[Aion]], though such efforts do not guarantee a response. He maintains vast treasure vaults containing numerous awakened items and possesses powerful servants, including entities that are themselves considered [[Elders]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kelarac is a massive, shark-like ocean creature with stony skin resembling an ancient wall and a dorsal fin as large as a tower. This being possesses a shark's head with silvery, triangular teeth and a [[steel]] blindfold bolted into its sockets. Other descriptions include dark or caramel skin, a gold-capped smile, and jeweled, ringed fingers.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A shrewd and deceptive bargainer, Kelarac is known to lace lies with truth and offer deals that often doom the other party. This [[Great Elder]] operates through an intent of greed and possession, frequently granting wishes in exchange for valuable items or souls. Despite being described by some as a fool, the entity is an open negotiator who enjoys buying people.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kelarac is a [[Reader of Memory]] who claims to possess infinite knowledge regarding the future, worlds, and human intent. The entity can use [[dreams]] and possesses a mark that allows for the sensing of [[Intent]]. Additionally, Kelarac is capable of taking a [[stone]] shark form and has been known to grant wishes or provide [[Awakened blades]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|War against Kelarac}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The conflict known as Kelarac's war serves as another name for the battle fought against Kelarac.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c26">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 26</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">1</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Kelarac]]'s war is one name for the battle against [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c26" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kelarac is known for purchasing people and marking his favorite slaves, though he was once blinded and nailed to the floor of the [[Aion Sea]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref> Mentioned by [[Estyr]], Kelarac is a person whom Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten was accused of consorting with and allegedly being enthralled by.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref> As the one holding the reins of The Empire{{!}}the Empire, Kelarac maintains influence over the Emperor and uses Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten as a pawn.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" /> After being marked by Kelarac, Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten may have been restored to life by him.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref> Kelarac gave Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine a gift containing a happy, muted song and is also considered a location that can be returned to.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20" /> While Kelarac's actions involve risk and fuel, he is a threat the city must fight, even though Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin believes something worse is coming.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref> Despite being described as a fool by [[Loreli]], Kelarac is open to negotiation and capable of offering deals.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" /> Urg’naut{{!}}Urg'naut has stated that he is not Kelarac, but he did mention that Kelarac is coming.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Final Battle}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius prepared for a confrontation with Kelarac, the initial difficulty in the war against him involved the logistics of fitting everyone onto [[Navigator ships]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref> This shark-like creature possesses stony skin and a rusted [[steel]] blindfold that is bolted to his face.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" /> While Kelarac is capable of taking a [[stone]] shark form and possesses an arsenal of weapons, he was ultimately devoured from the inside by energy turning on its origin.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref> Although Kelarac serves as a source of energy for [[Shera]], his power exists only within her.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" /> Despite his claim that he could be placed into an object and thrown into the ocean to remain a non-threat for centuries, Kelarac is dead.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 27</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The first challenge in the war against [[Kelarac]] was fitting everyone aboard [[Navigator ships]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius was preparing for a battle with [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Kelarac]] is a shark-like creature with stony skin and a [[steel]] blindfold.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Kelarac]] has a rusted [[steel]] blindfold bolted to his face.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Kelarac]] can take a [[stone]] shark form.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Kelarac]] was devoured from the inside by energy turning on its origin.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Kelarac]] is a source of energy for [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Kelarac]] claims he can be put into an object and thrown into the ocean to become no threat for centuries.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Kelarac]]'s power lives only in [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Kelarac]] has an arsenal of weapons.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Kelarac]] is dead.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“Kelarac is still free to act,” Jerri said.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“I’m pleased to see you again, Reader of Memory,” Kelarac said.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“Kelarac keeps his bargains,” Jerri responded.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“Kelarac is alive and we think he’s coming here. The sky is…wide open.”<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|It cost Kelarac to do this,” Jorin went on. “In fuel and in risk.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}
